hero.headline_line2: from the screen to the wire.
hero.description: Software, network and security engineer. I build the business systems companies run on every day, automate the networks beneath them, and I'm now specialising in securing both through a Master's in Information Systems Security. Laravel, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Flutter for products; Dolibarr for enterprise ERP; Python and Cisco-grade networking for infrastructure. Few engineers cover the product, the network and its security — that's the point.
hero.currently_text: At MCS Consulting — building the business systems clients run on every day: SOMAP RH, the HR and payroll system used across SOMAP's fuel stations, a land-portfolio management platform, and custom ERP modules for organisations such as CAMEC. Recently completed a full-stack and network engineering internship at A2 Holding (Jul – Aug 2026). Open to full-stack, backend and network-automation opportunities.
about.title: My Journey
about.subtitle: Software, network and security engineer — building production business systems, automating the networks beneath them, and securing both.
about.story1: I'm a Mauritanian Full-Stack Developer, now based in Tunis for my Master's in Information Systems Security. I build software people rely on at work — SOMAP RH, the HR and payroll system used every day by a national fuel-station network; a land-portfolio management platform; a mobile app published on the App Store and Google Play; six custom Dolibarr ERP modules in production; and AutoNetConfig, a toolkit that automates the configuration of network equipment. Laravel, React, Next.js and Flutter for products; PHP, MySQL and Dolibarr for enterprise ERP; CCNA networking when the wire matters.
about.story2: At MCS Consulting (since Dec 2025) I take business systems from the first meeting with the client to daily use. SOMAP RH follows station staff from their clock-in at the pump to their payslip, with payroll and payments the company can trust. For CAMEC, the national medical procurement agency, I replaced the Excel follow-up of international orders with a clear step-by-step workflow, document checklists and indicators. Alongside: a manufacturing ERP module, APOSB (point of sale and commerce management) and OMDHD, a trilingual Arabic, French and English institutional website. On my own time I led the development of Traiteurs, a catering app with Bankily, Masrivi and Sedad mobile payments, and co-built AutoNetConfig during my Moov Mauritel internship.
about.story3: The basics — APIs, databases, Docker, Linux, Git — are a given. What I bring is range: systems running in real businesses, hands-on ERP delivery, and a networking background that lets me understand what happens beneath the application — strengthened by my internship at A2 Holding, where software and ISP infrastructure meet. I'm open to full-stack, backend and network-automation roles where someone needs to hold the whole stack together, from the screen to the wire.

projects.responsibilities: Architected and developed the complete solution

projects.items.title: SOMAP RH
projects.items.description: The HR and payroll system SOMAP uses every day across its fuel stations, gas depots and agencies. Staff clock in from their phone at their workplace, with the location checked automatically. HR manages leave, salary advances and absences in one place, and payroll is calculated each month with every deduction explained on the payslip. Management follows attendance and payments on clear dashboards, and a daily presence report arrives on WhatsApp. Built to be reliable with money: no double payments, a full history of every change, and hundreds of automated tests before each release.

projects.items.title: Patrimoine Foncier
projects.items.description: A platform that gives a property owner a complete view of their land portfolio: every parcel, how it was bought and paid for, the projects built on it, expenses, mortgages, and sales with the final profit. Executives see the overall picture and trends on one dashboard and export reports to Excel or PDF in one click. Each user only sees what their role allows, every action is recorded, and financial records are never deleted — so the numbers can always be trusted.

projects.items.title: CAMEC Import Tracking
projects.items.description: Built for CAMEC, Mauritania's central purchasing agency for medicines and medical equipment, to replace the Excel files used to follow international orders. Each order is tracked step by step from the purchase order to final delivery, with automatic delay alerts, the documents required for each shipment, and reminders to suppliers and forwarders. A dashboard shows the agency's key indicators and what needs attention today. Delivered with user and administrator guides and a full acceptance test with the client.

projects.items.title: Traiteurs App
projects.items.description: A mobile app on the App Store and Google Play that connects customers with caterers and delivery drivers. Customers order and pay with Mauritanian mobile money (Bankily, Masrivi, Sedad), caterers manage their orders, and drivers are followed live on the map until delivery. I led the development in a small team and also built the admin console the operations team uses to follow orders, drivers and commissions.

projects.items.title: APOSB
projects.items.description: Professional POS and commerce management system for boutiques, supermarkets and small businesses. Covers sales, purchases, stock management, invoices, partial payments, user roles and permissions, and MRU-based reporting dashboards (daily sales, customer dues, product performance, inventory and cashier activity). Delivered a premium business UI with realistic Mauritanian demo data and full Docker deployment.

projects.items.title: Fabrication ERP
projects.items.description: An ERP module that runs a manufacturing business end to end: buying raw materials and packaging, recording each production run, receiving and delivering goods, and selling in cash, on credit or as raw material. The owner sees the real cost of each product, stock levels, purchases and sales at any time, with Arabic documents ready to print and expenses and salaries tracked in the same place.

projects.items.title: AutoNetConfig
projects.items.description: Python + Netmiko + Flask toolkit co-built during the Moov Mauritel internship. Automates SSH device configuration across Cisco-class equipment with Netmiko, scans hosts/ports and maps topologies with Nmap, and serves a real-time visualisation layer over Flask. Designed, built and validated on EVE-NG labs alongside GNS3 and Packet Tracer.

projects.items.title: OxCoreX
projects.items.description: A mobile-first crypto investment platform with an Arabic interface for users and an English admin panel. Users deposit and withdraw USDT, verify their identity and invite friends through a referral program, while the team reviews and approves operations from the admin panel. Sensitive actions are protected by a separate transaction password.

projects.items.title: OMDHD
projects.items.description: Official website for a Mauritanian NGO focused on human rights and social development. Built 15+ pages covering news, reports, intervention areas, donation, volunteer and contact flows. Implemented a native trilingual experience in Arabic, French and English with full RTL support, Framer Motion animations, responsive layouts and a content architecture ready for CMS integration.

projects.items.title: Sadara Media
projects.items.description: Arabic-first RTL news platform built on Next.js with server-side rendering for SEO. Delivered an editorial RTL interface inspired by the Sadara visual identity, a custom CMS for article drafting, publishing workflow, media uploads and category management, a rich homepage and a complete back office — polished across mobile, tablet and desktop.

projects.items.title: GestionParc
projects.items.description: A fleet management module for vehicles, equipment, maintenance and fuel — including ambulance refuelling and an internal fuel station. Managers know which vehicle used what, when and how much, and get ready-to-print PDF reports.

projects.items.title: MCS Consulting
projects.items.description: Official corporate website for MCS Consulting, a firm specialized in financial consulting and ERP solutions. Delivered a high-performance, responsive digital presence that strengthens the firm's brand identity and serves as a primary lead generation tool for enterprise clients.
